integrity: The stated all-size claim is supported by a complete algebraic and spectral proof; the exact finite rational checker corroborates, but does not replace, the infinite argument. Source-date evidence comes from the initial public arXiv release, rather than a revision date.
scientific_limitations: Two-block sign-reversing cycles on a uniformly weighted undirected complete graph; local exponential attraction only modulo common translation; strict spectral region only; no nonlinear claim at equality boundaries, global basin, or arbitrary opinion-clipping effects. Full historical priority and external validation remain unestablished.
title: Unequal two-camp oscillations in cubic complete-graph opinion dynamics: the sharp one-third barrier
